description: List the caller's OWN Stripe invoices — status/amounts (minor units)/currency/hosted_invoice_url/period (from stripe_invoices, owner-scoped to the caller's OAuth sub), newest first. Optional `limit` (default 50, max 200). A billing:view operator may pass `all_users:true` for the fleet. Returns { count, invoices:[…] }.

all_users.description: billing:view/admin only — return EVERY account's invoices.

name: list_invoices
title: List Invoices
